issue: Which title/abstract decisions enter full-text screening
original_protocol: Protocol file unavailable. The brief keeps MAYBE as its own decision and does not say to drop it.
decision: Provisional operational rule: INCLUDE and MAYBE are queued for full text. EXCLUDE is not. Stored decisions are not rewritten.
rationale: A queue is required for the full-text sheet. MAYBE would have no next step if it were dropped. Confirm against the protocol before treating this as final.
notes: If the protocol sends only INCLUDE to full text
column12: change the queue and add a new decision-log row. Do not recode existing MAYBE rows as part of that change.

issue: When a flagged duplicate is removed from PRISMA counts
original_protocol: Duplicates are flagged rather than automatically deleted.
decision: A record is counted as removed only when human_decision is SAME_RECORD and retained_record_id names which record stays. Otherwise the pair remains flagged and both records stay in the set.
rationale: This follows the instruction not to delete candidates automatically. retained_record_id was added so the count does not guess which row to drop.
notes: Conference and journal versions are not collapsed by the detector.

made_by: The normalizer also strips https://dx.doi.org/ and http://dx.doi.org/. The raw DOI string is kept in doi_raw.
prospective_or_retrospective: dx.doi.org is the same resolver form. Stripping it avoids false non-matches. It does not change eligibility.
